# Spec: item-kind-downgrade
<!-- Generated by /hefesto:hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-11-15 -->
<!-- Board item: HEF-54 (found by HEF-30's verify gate 2026-11-13, scan MEDIUM; target 9.4.2) -->
<!-- req-coverage: scoped -->

## Overview

`ledger.sh record <id> --item-kind <k>` (`hooks/ledger.sh:697`) is open to any session, so an `incident` or
`vulnerability` entry can be relabelled `feature`, and `automerge` (`hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:239`) then drops
the kind's gate from its PASS list and merges under `merge_by: auto`. This change makes a kind change away from
`incident`/`vulnerability` a person's signature or the launcher's own record, makes `automerge` read the kind
recorded at intake, and adds a smoke case that forges the downgrade and gets no merge.

## Context (read from the code, 2026-11-15)

- `init` records `item_kind` (`hooks/ledger.sh:439,450`); `register` (`hooks/ledger-lanes.sh:24,39`) calls `init`
  with the kind `status-board.sh --item-kind` detected. Nothing else in `hooks/` calls `record --item-kind`; only
  the launcher's corrupt-kind message (`hooks/session-launch.sh:240`) and the tests name it.
- `record` is in `LEDGER_ALLOW` (`hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:151`); its signature flags (`--body-file`,
  `--body-from-board`, `--rfc`) are in `LEDGER_SIGN_FLAG` (`:144`) and so get an ask rule. `is_person_sub`
  (`hooks/lane-lib.sh:56`) already treats `record … --reviewed-by-human` as a person's decision, and lane-guard's
  `SIGN_FLAGS` (`hooks/lane-guard.sh:120`) already enforces its plain spelling — but `record` does not parse
  `--reviewed-by-human` / `--by` today (`usage` on any unknown flag).
- The launcher marker is `HEFESTO_LAUNCHER=1` with no `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` (`launcher_gate`,
  `hooks/ledger.sh:284-288`; `verified_head_set`, `hooks/ledger-automerge.sh:46`).
- The verify launcher requires the kind's gate from the entry's current `item_kind`
  (`hooks/session-launch.sh:233,405`).
- `CHANGELOG.md` 9.4.1 (`:84`) names the defect and the workaround (`merge_by: lane`).

## Decisions taken without a clarification (documented, reviewable)

- **D1 — the intake kind is a separate, write-once field.** `init` records `intake_kind` equal to `item_kind`.
  Only a signed or launcher kind change rewrites it (a signed change is a re-intake of the kind). An unsigned
  `record --item-kind` never touches it.
- **D2 — "a lighter kind" means any other kind.** A change whose CURRENT `item_kind` is `incident` or
  `vulnerability`, to any different value, needs the signature (incident ↔ vulnerability included: each drops the
  other's gate). A change from `feature`, or to the same value, stays open to any session — it only adds a gate.
- **D3 — automerge reads both kinds, heavier wins.** The kind gates `automerge` requires are the union of
  `item_kind` and `intake_kind`, each kept when it is `incident` or `vulnerability`. An entry written before this
  change has no `intake_kind`; it falls back to `item_kind` alone (after this change that field can no longer be
  lowered unsigned, so the fallback is no weaker than the new path). Every missing kind gate falls back to
  `human:merge` — the ordinary form path — as a missing gate does today.
- **D4 — the signature is `--reviewed-by-human --by <name>` on `record`.** Same name shape as `unblock`'s and
  `merge-auto grant`'s; refused inside a launched worker; it gets an ask rule (`record --reviewed-by-human` in
  `LEDGER_SIGN_FLAG`), so in a set-up project in `default` permission mode the person answers a dialog. It is
  accepted only together with `--item-kind`; on any other `record` call it is refused, so no signature is
  recorded that nothing reads.
- **D5 — every signed or launcher call that changes `item_kind` or `intake_kind` leaves an event.**
  `.events += {kind: "item-kind-changed", by: <name or "launcher">, at, note: "<field from → to, both fields>"}`.
- **D5b — the launcher path has no caller today.** The item asks for it in so many words: *"a kind change from
  incident/vulnerability to a lighter kind is a person's signature (`--reviewed-by-human --by`) or the
  launcher's"*. It is kept, with its own negative test: the marker together with a session id is refused.
- **D6 — out of scope.** The verify launcher keeps reading `item_kind` (a forged state already fails closed at
  `automerge`). The premise that a dialog is the signature needs `default` permission mode, as for every other
  signature (`session-start-context.sh` warns); this item does not change it. No new `/hefesto:hef.orchestrate`
  form: a person who needs to correct a kind runs the signed form from the orchestrator. `intake_kind` is a
  second layer behind the `record` guard. It does not defend against a session that can write the ledger file
  itself; that folder sits outside every sandbox's write set. Nor does it defend against **pre-emption at
  intake**. `init` is allowed to any session (`hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:151`) and takes `--item-kind` from its
  caller (`hooks/ledger.sh:439`), while `register` leaves an existing entry untouched
  (`hooks/ledger-lanes.sh:17`). So a session that runs `init <id> … --item-kind feature` before the orchestrator
  registers an incident fixes both fields at `feature`. That is a separate defect with a separate fix (`init`
  re-reading the board's kind, or `init` refusing a kind that differs from the board's). It is recorded in the
  CHANGELOG as a known issue and proposed as a follow-up board item. This fix is not widened to cover it.

## User Scenarios

### US1: An unsigned downgrade is refused [P1]
- **Given** an entry recorded as `incident` (or `vulnerability`)
- **When** any session runs `ledger.sh record <id> --item-kind feature` without `--reviewed-by-human --by`, and
  without the launcher marker
- **Then** the call exits non-zero naming the signature it needs, and `item_kind` and `intake_kind` are unchanged
- **Edge**: `record <id> --item-kind incident` on an incident (same value) succeeds; `feature → incident` succeeds
  unsigned and leaves `intake_kind` alone
- **Error**: `--reviewed-by-human` from inside a launched worker (`HEFESTO_WORKER=1`) is refused

### US2: A person's signed downgrade, or the launcher's, is honoured [P1]
- **Given** an entry recorded as `incident`
- **When** a person runs `record <id> --item-kind feature --reviewed-by-human --by Ana` (or the launcher runs
  `record <id> --item-kind feature` with its marker)
- **Then** `item_kind` and `intake_kind` become `feature` and an `item-kind-changed` event names `Ana` (or
  `launcher`) and `incident → feature`
- **Edge**: `--by` with a name that fails the shape (empty, a control character) is refused
- **Error**: `--reviewed-by-human --by Ana` on a `record` call with no `--item-kind` is refused, nothing written

### US3: automerge requires the intake kind's gate [P1]
- **Given** `merge_by: auto` under a matching grant, a green PR at its verified head, the four gates PASS, and an
  entry whose `intake_kind` is `incident` while `item_kind` reads `feature` (a forged downgrade)
- **When** the deploy launcher runs `ledger.sh automerge <id>`
- **Then** it exits 2, blocks `human:merge` with "gate incident is not PASS", and `gh pr merge` is never invoked
- **Edge**: a legacy entry with no `intake_kind` and `item_kind: incident` still requires the incident gate
- **Negative**: an entry with `intake_kind` and `item_kind` both `feature` (a signed downgrade) merges

### US4: The smoke suite forges the downgrade [P1]
- **Given** the merge-auto fixture (`tests/smoke-automerge.sh`)
- **When** a session forges the downgrade (the unsigned `record`, then a hand-edited `item_kind`)
- **Then** neither path reaches `gh pr merge`, and two mutations — the record guard removed, the intake kind
  dropped from automerge's gate list — each turn the suite red

### US5: Setup and docs carry the new signature [P2]
- **Given** `hefesto-setup.sh` writes the signature ask rules
- **When** it runs
- **Then** `Bash(<hooks>/ledger.sh record * --reviewed-by-human*)` is among them, `--check` accepts it, and
  `docs/install.md`, `docs/hooks.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` say so

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `init` records `intake_kind` equal to the `item_kind` it records | P1 | US3 |
| FR-002 | `record --item-kind <k>` where the current `item_kind` is `incident` or `vulnerability` and `<k>` differs is refused unless the call carries `--reviewed-by-human --by <name>` or the launcher marker (`HEFESTO_LAUNCHER=1` **and** no `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID`; the marker with a session id is no launcher); the refusal names the signed form and writes nothing | P1 | US1 |
| FR-003 | A signed or launcher kind change sets both `item_kind` and `intake_kind` and appends an `item-kind-changed` event with by, at and `<from> → <to>` | P1 | US2 |
| FR-004 | A signature is both `--reviewed-by-human` and a well-formed `--by`; either alone does not sign. `record --reviewed-by-human` is refused inside a launched worker, with a `--by` that fails the name shape, and on a call without `--item-kind` | P1 | US1, US2 |
| FR-005 | An unsigned `record --item-kind` from `feature`, or to the same value, still succeeds and leaves `intake_kind` unchanged | P1 | US1 |
| FR-006 | `automerge` requires a PASS for every gate in the union of `item_kind` and `intake_kind` restricted to `incident`/`vulnerability`; an entry without `intake_kind` uses `item_kind` alone | P1 | US3 |
| FR-007 | A smoke case in `tests/smoke-item-kind.sh` (a part file sourced from `tests/smoke-automerge.sh`, reusing its merge-auto fixture) forges the downgrade (unsigned `record`; a hand-edited `item_kind` under an `incident` intake kind) and asserts no `gh pr merge` on the fake's log, plus a signed-downgrade case that merges | P1 | US4 |
| FR-008 | Mutations of the record guard and of automerge's intake-kind read are each caught by the suite | P1 | US4 |
| FR-009 | `hefesto-setup.sh` lists `record --reviewed-by-human` in `LEDGER_SIGN_FLAG`; `docs/install.md`, `docs/hooks.md`, `commands/hef.orchestrate.md` (the person's-decision rule), `ledger.sh`'s usage line and `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` (Fixed, Upgrade: re-run `hefesto-setup.sh`, known issue: `init` pre-emption) describe the signature and the intake kind | P2 | US5 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | With a forged downgrade, `automerge` exits 2 and the fake gh log holds no `pr merge` | `tests/smoke-item-kind.sh` case (FR-007) |
| SC-002 | An unsigned `record --item-kind feature` on an incident exits non-zero and the entry file is byte-identical | smoke case comparing the entry before/after |
| SC-003 | Each FR-008 mutation turns the suite red | mutation block in the smoke file |
| SC-004 | `bash tests/smoke.sh` tier 1 passes, `shellcheck` is clean on the changed hooks | run both |

## Clarifications
_None — every open point was decidable from the code; see Decisions D1–D6._
